newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai finmin readies measures to shore up bourse.
newsitem.headline: Thai finmin readies measures to shore up bourse.

text.p: Thai Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan said on Tuesday he would announce new measures to shore up the battered stock market after the government presents its policy statement to parliament next week.
"I have prepared a plan to solve the current slump in the stock market. It will be announced after the government's policy presentation," Amnuay told reporters. He gave no further details.
The government is scheduled to present its policy statement on December 11.

Thailand's bourse is hovering near three-year lows with investors waiting to see what the new government which came to power after the November 17 polls will do to lift sentiment and boost a slowing economy.
Amnuay was speaking during a visit to the Stock Exchange of Thailand with Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh on Tuesday afternoon.
Chavalit said his government was keen on boosting investor confidence in Thailand and added that he believed his new government would be acceptable to foreign investors.
Amnuay said that among his priorities as finance minister was bolstering the slumping property sector and solving a liquidity problem faced by many financial institutions.
